governance.stableSecurity: Standard — Stable Release Security Blockers v1.0

finalStableRequirements: Select the exact merged Stable-eligible source revision only after all prior Stable blockers close.
Produce the final Stable runtime/source artifact from that exact revision through a controlled release workflow.
Record exact source commit and tree identity.
Record artifact name, size, SHA-256 checksum, and supported distribution boundary.
Retain an applicable CycloneDX SBOM covering the released runtime/source boundary and separately accepted build/supply-chain evidence.
Retain provenance tying the final artifact bytes to the exact approved source revision and release workflow.
Retain signing or attestation evidence when required by the final release workflow or governance.
Retain final Stable security acceptance for the same exact candidate.
Retain rollback binding to GLAZE UI 1.5.1.
After publication, read back the immutable tag/release/artifact identity and verify it matches the approved revision and evidence.
Update lifecycle, release, documentation, task, and consumer-target records only after the authoritative publication state is verified.
unresolvedPrerequisites: Selection of the exact Stable revision after those blockers close.
boundary: This record prepares and validates the packaging/provenance path only. Rehearsal artifacts are Release Candidate evidence, are not final Stable artifacts, and must not be tagged, published, deployed, or treated as consumer-eligible Stable output.
